en: The Dyad on Roots to be Abandoned by Cultivation (Bhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduka)

Dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned by cultivation (*bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuka*), a state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of the root-condition (*hetupaccaya*).
Dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned by cultivation, a state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, there are nine; in the object condition, six; in the predominance condition, five ... pe ... in the ripening condition, one ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, nine.
